items.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>We give a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of an enhancement of a finite triangulated category. Moreover, we show that enhancements are unique when they exist, up to Morita equivalence.</jats:p>

items.abstract: <jats:p>We develop a theory of minimal models for algebras over a Koszul operad with trivial differential defined over a commutative ring (containing <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$\mathbb {Q}$</jats:tex-math><jats:inline-graphic xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" mime-subtype="png" xlink:href="S0308210522000427_inline1.png"/></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> in the symmetric case), not necessarily a field, extending and supplementing the work of Sagave for the associative case. Our minimal models are bigraded and contain a projective resolution of the homology.</jats:p>
title: Derived homotopy algebras
